verification_methodology.disclosure: Coffee beans are modeled as 36 discrete 1.0 g free-body rigid ellipsoid parcels inside a bench-supported hopper chute above a motorized MuJoCo sliding shutter gate. The handled dosing cup rests physically on the catch tray inside a low-profile guide slot and is moved exclusively by measured closed-finger contact from the UR5e's Robotiq 2F-85 gripper (no cup mocap or scripted cup forces). Bean conservation across hopper, cup, and catch tray, plus gripper-cup contact force and clearance traces, are logged independently after rest.
